entities.name: Micael Bydén
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: General Per Micael Bydén is a retired Swedish Air Force officer. Bydén served as Supreme Commander of the Swedish Armed Forces from 2015 to 2024. Prior to that, he served as the Chief of Air Force and commander of the Air Component Command from 2012 and 2015.

entities.name: Micael Bydén
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: General Per Micael Bydén is a retired Swedish Air Force officer. Bydén served as Supreme Commander of the Swedish Armed Forces from 2015 to 2024. Prior to that, he served as the Chief of Air Force and commander of the Air Component Command from 2012 and 2015.
